The '''Sagaci Springs''' are a popular natural attraction and exploration mechanic found in [[Mt. Firmament]]. These hot springs are concentrated around [[Hongzhen]].

Swimming in the Sagaci Springs will restore HP over time to all [[Resonators]] in the player's team.
